574-678-5865.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn
574-678-5865.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-678-5865.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

2511-5254-7741.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2511-5254-7741.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-2459-4948-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Estrid's Invocation trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Estrid's Invocation.
Repeat.

2018-3216-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Suncleanser.
When Suncleanser dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Suncleanser from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Suncleanser enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Suncleanser.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

225-1308-3129-4094-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-1308-3129-4094-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3129-4094-6441-6763-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1409-1636-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures, three of which are Elves excluding Thranduil that do not have summoning sickness.
1409-1636-7892.description:
Activate two Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters, its soulbond ability and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it with Thranduil.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1409-1636-7892.notes: If you happen to control an Elf that has haste, you can perform the combo only controlling two Elves and blink the Elf with haste each loop. Otherwise, you can blink Thranduil or any other creature that isn't tapping for mana.

489-1621-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1494-3017-7720-7737.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2724-4006-7334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
2724-4006-7334.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using The Neutrinos. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushbringer.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7415.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Old-Growth Educator.
When Old-Growth Educator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Old-Growth Educator enters, it triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie

2105-6968-7196.description:
Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Grub trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Combat Celebrant and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of it.
Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

5686-6112-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5686-6112-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Fumulus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

698-6867-6869.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
698-6867-6869.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 3.

851-1274-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
851-1274-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

483-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
483-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk
with four or more quest counters on it

3908-7009-7012.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
3908-7009-7012.description:
Activate Spark Double using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

2034-3564-4275-5329.easyPrerequisites: You control another untapped nontoken Merfolk.
2034-3564-4275-5329.description:
Activate Kumena's first ability by tapping another nontoken Merfolk you control.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kumena ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk token.
When the Merfolk dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Merfolk.
Repeat.
2034-3564-4275-5329.notes: You can tap as many nontoken Merfolk as able each iteration by repeating steps 1 through 3 for each Merfolk. They will all be untapped by Faces of the Past.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6096-6968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6096-6968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6096-6968.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

141-2511-3495.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2511-3495.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2511-3495.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

1778-5220-6798-6900.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

549-2919-4186-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-2919-4186-6830.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating an artifact creature token.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

974-1235-4823.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of the Smaug token and Timeless Witness with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Smaug token that died and the Timeless Witness token trigger.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

4053-5499-6633--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4053-5499-6633--5.description:
Activate the creature with persist by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the persist creature.
Repeat.

1003-1329-2178-4779.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1003-1329-2178-4779.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

2060-3062-4893-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-3062-4893-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

348-2178-2577-5631.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Priest of Forgotten Gods.
Priest of Forgotten Gods does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Zombie, and at least one additional creature except Gravecrawler or the Zombie.
348-2178-2577-5631.description:
Activate Priest of Forgotten Gods by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler and any other creature.
When the creatures die, Priest of Forgotten Gods triggers twice, untapping itself.
Resolve the Priest of Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, and causing you to add {B}{B} and draw a card.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a 2/2 Skeleton Pirate creature token.
Repeat.

1636-3484-4023-4840-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Dr Madison Li does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least five energy counters.
1636-3484-4023-4840-5147.description:
Activate Dr Madison Li's third ability by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlepshere enters the battlefield, it, Intruder Alarm and Decoction Module triggers.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
When the Myrs enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Decoction Module trigger four times.
Resolve all Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve all Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

783-2092-4954.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 7 or greater.
783-2092-4954.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Jungle Basin and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

824-2728-4050-4153.notablePrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch and Leech Bonder do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent controls a creature.
824-2728-4050-4153.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch and Leech Bonder as attackers.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto another creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.
